script.direction: A warm, articulate tutorial creator showing a useful tool to a friend. Curious and genuinely pleased, never breathless or announcer-like. Natural American English, lightly smiling tone, varied emphasis, clear consonants, about 150 words per minute. Speak the narration exactly. Do not read section titles. Leave a clean 0.8-second pause between paragraphs. No music or sound effects.

segments.text: From a first idea to a finished lesson. Welcome to AI Video Tutorial Generator.
Keep each lesson's sources, scenes, and media together in one local project.
Choose a cloud provider, or download a local model. The download panel keeps you updated while you continue working.
Start with included teaching backgrounds and slide elements. Image generation is optional, so a well-designed lesson doesn't need another API call.
Give your tutorial a cast. Pick realistic, anime or cartoon hosts, or a playful animal, and assign speakers to different scenes.
For an illustrated scene, review your locally generated artwork and keep the version you want.
Then refine the actual timeline. Move between tools with a single icon dock. Make more room for your transcript, resize the tracks, and keep the preview in view.
Here are four visual styles, with real, locally rendered lip-sync.
Your lesson. Your cast. Ready to review and export.

chapterPolicy.description: Internal cuts use the midpoint between the prior segment's last word end and next segment's first word start. Source start/end preserve 200 ms around the first/last spoken word where available.
chapterPolicy.timelineAdjustment: The model left longer natural pauses than requested. Use each segment's recommendedTimelineInSeconds and recommendedTimelineOutSeconds to retain 0.4 seconds on each side of internal boundaries, yielding 0.8 seconds between spoken paragraphs while preserving at least 0.2 seconds of lead/tail.
